text: こども　あいてに　たたかっても　しょうきんは　たまらねえん　だよ

structure.jp: たまらねえん　だよ

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus も means 'even if'. たたかっても = 'even if you battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) at the end gives the feel of explaining how things are, like 'you see'. たまらねえん　だ = 'it doesn't pile up, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねえ is a rough, tough-guy way of saying ない, 'not'. たまらねえ = 'doesn't pile up'.
